transcript.en: OK Rosie, shall we try to get some ideas together for our presentation on diet and obesity?
transcript.zh: 好的，Rosie, 咱们一起试着给我们关于饮食和肥胖的演讲想一些观点好吗？

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 可以。

transcript.en: I can talk about the experiment I did to see if people can tell the difference between real sugar and artificial sweeteners.
transcript.zh: 我可以分享我做过的一个实验，这个实验的目的是看看大家是否可以区别出真的糖和人造代糖。

transcript.en: Where you gave people drinks with either sugar or artificial sweeteners and they had to say which they thought it was?
transcript.zh: 你是给实验对象喝带有糖或者是代糖的饮料让他们说出自己喝的是哪种糖吗？

transcript.en: Yeah. It took me ages to decide exactly how I'd organise it,
transcript.zh: 没错，这个实验花了我很长的时间来筹备，

transcript.en: especially how I could make sure that people didn't know which drink I was giving them.
transcript.zh: 尤其是怎么样才能让实验者不知道我给他们的是哪种饮料。

transcript.en: It was hard to keep track of it all, especially as I had so many people doing it -
transcript.zh: 记录整个过程挺难的，因为我有很多的实验对象，

transcript.en: I had to make sure I kept a proper record of what each person had had.
transcript.zh: 我需要保证准确无误地记录下每个人喝的是什么。

transcript.en: So could most people tell the difference?
transcript.zh: 是大部分人都能尝出他们的不同吗？

transcript.en: Yeah-I hadn't thought they would be able to, but most people could.
transcript.zh: 是的，我没想到会是这个结果，但确实，大多数人可以。

transcript.en: Then there's that experiment I did measuring the fat content of nuts,to see if the nutritional information given on the packet was accurate.
transcript.zh: 我做的实验是检测坚果里的脂肪含量，目的是核实一下包装袋上给出的营养成分表的数据是否准确。

transcript.en: The one where you ground up the nuts and mixed them with a chemical to absorb the fat?
transcript.zh: 你的实验是不是把坚果磨碎后再融合化学剂去吸收脂肪？

transcript.en: Yes. My results were a bit problematic-the fat content for that type of nut seemed much lower than it said on the package.
transcript.zh: 是的，我的实验结果有点问题，我的数据显示脂肪含量比包装上写的低了很多。

transcript.en: But I reckon the package information was right.I think I should probably have ground up the nuts more than I did.
transcript.zh: 但我觉得包装上的信息是对的。我觉得我其实应该把坚果研磨更多次。

transcript.en: It's possible that the scales for weighing the fat weren't accurate enough, too. I'd really like to try the experiment again some time.
transcript.zh: 也有可能是称量脂肪的天平不够准确。有机会我还想试着再做一次这个实验。

transcript.en: So what can we say about helping people to lose weight?
transcript.zh: 所以在帮助大家减肥的这一部分，我们该说些什么呢。

transcript.en: There's a lot we could say about what restaurants could do to reduce obesity.
transcript.zh: 我们可以讲很多关于餐厅如何做以减少人们的肥胖。

transcript.en: I read that the items at the start of a menu and the items at the end of a menu are much more likely to be chosen than the items in the middle.
transcript.zh: 我读到过在菜单前面的菜品和在菜单最后的菜品比在菜单中间的菜品更容易被点到。

transcript.en: So, if you put the low-calorie items at the beginning and end of the menu,
transcript.zh: 所以如果餐厅把低卡路里的菜品放在菜单的前面或后面，

transcript.en: people will probably go for the food with fewer calories, without even realising what they're doing.
transcript.zh: 人们就可能会去选择这些低热量的食物，甚至他们都没有意识到自己是这么做的。

transcript.en: I think food manufacturers could do more to encourage healthy eating. How?
transcript.zh: 我觉得食品生产商可以做一些事情来鼓励健康饮食。比如说呢？

transcript.en: Well, when manufacturers put calorie counts of a food on the label, they're sometimes really confusing and I suspect they do it on purpose.
transcript.zh: 食品生产商把食品的热量放在标签上的时候，这些热量表有时候会有迷惑性，我觉得他们是有意这么去做的。

transcript.en: Because food that's high in calories tastes better, and so they'll sell more.
transcript.zh: 因为高热量的食物更好吃，所以他们会卖得更多。

transcript.en: Yeah, so if you look at the amount of calories in a pizza,
transcript.zh: 是的，如果你看一下一个披萨的热量，

transcript.en: they'll give you the calories per quarter pizza and you think, oh that's not too bad. But who's going to eat a quarter pizza? Exactly.
transcript.zh: 他们给你提供的是四分之一披萨的热量，你看完后会觉得热量不高，但是谁会只吃四分之一的披萨呢？确实是。

transcript.en: I suppose another approach to this problem is to get people to exercise more.
transcript.zh: 我认为，另一个减少肥胖的方法是让人们去做更多的运动。

transcript.en: Right. In England, the current guidelines are for at least 30 minutes of brisk walking, five days a week.
transcript.zh: 没错 ，英格兰现在的运动指南建议至少快走30分钟，一周做五天。

transcript.en: Now when you ask them, about 40% of men and 30% of women say they do this,
transcript.zh: 当你问人们的时候，大约40%的男人和30%的女人会说他们做到了，

transcript.en: but when you objectively measure the amount of walking they do with motion sensors,
transcript.zh: 但是当我们客观地用运动传感器去监测他们走了多少路的时候，

transcript.en: you find that only 6% of men and 4% of women do the recommended amount of exercise.
transcript.zh: 你会发现只有6%的男人和4%的女人完成了推荐的运动量。

transcript.en: Mm, so you can see why obesity is growing.
transcript.zh: 所以你看这就是为什么肥胖率正在增长。

transcript.en: So how can people be encouraged to take more exercise?
transcript.zh: 那么该如何鼓励人们去做更多的运动呢？

transcript.en: Well, for example, think of the location of stairs in a train station.
transcript.zh: 比如说，想想这个火车站楼梯的位置。

transcript.en: If people reach the stairs before they reach the escalator when they're leaving the station,
transcript.zh: 当乘客离开车站的时候，如果他们在走到扶梯之前就可以走到楼梯的话，

transcript.en: they're more likely to take the stairs. And if you increase the width of the stairs, you'll get more people using them at the same time.
transcript.zh: 他们更可能会使用楼梯。另外，如果我们增加了楼梯的宽度，你会发现在同一时间会有更多的人使用楼梯，

transcript.en: It's an unconscious process and influenced by minor modifications in their environment.
transcript.zh: 这个过程是无意识的，是由环境中的小改变影响的。

transcript.en: Right. And it might not be a big change, but if it happens every day, it all adds up.
transcript.zh: 没错，这可能不是一个大的改变，但是如果每天都发生的话，就会累积的。

transcript.en: Yes. But actually, I'm not sure if we should be talking about exercise in our presentation.
transcript.zh: 我不确定，我们该不该在演讲中讲锻炼的事情。

transcript.en: Well, we've done quite a bit of reading about it.
transcript.zh: 实际上我们做了很多关于这方面的阅读。

transcript.en: I know, but it's going to mean we have a very wide focus, and our tutor did say that we need to focus on causes and solutions in terms of nutrition.
transcript.zh: 我知道，但是这意味着我们关注点比较宽泛，导师确实和我们说过，应该关注肥胖在营养层面的原因和解决方案。

transcript.en: I suppose so. And we've got plenty of information about that. OK, well that will be simpler.
transcript.zh: 我觉得也是这样，我们已经有很多这方面的信息了，这样会简单很多。

transcript.en: So what shall we do now? We've still got half an hour before our next lecture.
transcript.zh: 那么我们现在该做什么呢，距离下节课上课还有半小时。

transcript.en: Let's think about what we're going to include and what will go where. Then we can decide what slides we need.
transcript.zh: 那咱们一起想一想演讲的内容和内容分配吧，然后可以决定我们需要什么样的幻灯片。

transcript.en: OK, fine.
transcript.zh: 好的，没问题。
